Export a criteria pipeline to YAML

Source: R/yaml.R
export_criteria.Rd

Serialises a cf_criteria object to a human-readable YAML file (or string). The schema is self-describing and can be re-imported with import_criteria().

Usage

export_criteria(criteria, path = NULL, fn_refs = list())

Arguments

criteria

A cf_criteria object.

path

A file path to write to. If NULL (default), the YAML text is returned as a character string.

fn_refs

An optional named list mapping function objects to "pkg::name" reference strings.

Value

When path = NULL, the YAML text as a character string (returned visibly, so it prints at the console). Otherwise, invisibly, the criteria object.

YAML schema

cohortflow_criteria:
  version: 1
  steps:
    - label:  "Adults only"
      type:   include
      kind:   formula
      by:     null
      expr:   "age >= 18"
      fn_ref: null
      category: null
      reason: "Under 18"   # only written when set

A file with a higher version than this package reads is refused with an error.

Formula-based criteria round-trip cleanly. For function predicates (kind: function), expr holds the full deparsed function source, including its argument list and any default values (e.g. "function(d, thr = 18) d$age >= thr"); complex closures may not round-trip and a warning is issued. Named exported functions can be stored as "pkg::name" references via fn_refs. Files written by earlier versions, which stored the function body in expr and the argument names in a separate fn_args field, can still be imported, with a warning that default argument values were not stored and the file should be re-saved.

See also

import_criteria() to read the file back.

Other yaml: import_criteria()

Examples

crit <- cf_criteria() |>
  include(~ age >= 18, label = "Adults only", category = "Age") |>
  exclude(~ withdrew,  label = "Withdrew consent")

# As a string
cat(export_criteria(crit))
#> cohortflow_criteria:
#>   version: 1
#>   steps:
#>   - label: Adults only
#>     type: include
#>     kind: formula
#>     by: ~
#>     expr: age >= 18
#>     fn_ref: ~
#>     category: Age
#>     arms: ~
#>   - label: Withdrew consent
#>     type: exclude
#>     kind: formula
#>     by: ~
#>     expr: withdrew
#>     fn_ref: ~
#>     category: ~
#>     arms: ~

# To a file, then back again
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
export_criteria(crit, path = path)
import_criteria(path = path)
#> Cohort criteria pipeline  (2 steps)
#>    1. [+][~] (include) {Age} Adults only
#>           age >= 18
#>    2. [-][~] (exclude) Withdrew consent
#>           withdrew
unlink(path)
